how_to_apply: Eligible serving government officers/employees apply on the prescribed form (Annexure D), typed on a computer.

Attach a self-attested certificate that no departmental inquiry is pending.
Send to the Divisional Commissioner's Office, Awar, Nashik Road - 422101.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Divisional Administrative Training Institute, Nashik Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Divisional Administrative Training Institute, Nashik Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 1 Registrar and Assistant Professor (Group A), 8 Assistant Professor (Group A), 1 Librarian (Group C).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Divisional Administrative Training Institute, Nashik Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure D attached to the notice (page 2-3)) and send it to Divisional Administrative Training Institute, Nashik (Nashik Revenue Training Institute), Divisional Commissioner's Office, Awar, Nashik Road - 422101, by by post or in person during office hours, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: S-19 (Rs. 55,100-1,75,100) for Registrar and Assistant Professor (Group A), S-19 (Rs. 55,100-1,75,100) for Assistant Professor (Group A), S-8 (Rs. 25,500-81,100) for Librarian (Group C).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only officers/employees currently working in government service can apply. Educational qualifications are not stated. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Conditions and terms set by the government for deputation under the cited Government Resolutions apply.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons not currently working in government service. Candidates who applied earlier in response to the 2024-25 advertisements must not apply again, as their applications were not approved by the government.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received by the last date will be scrutinised. Eligible officers/employees will be informed of the interview date. Proposals of candidates selected at interview will be sent to the General Administration Department, Government of Maharashtra. Interview of eligible candidates after scrutiny of applications.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nashik.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate from head of office that the applicant is currently in government service; Self-attested certificate that no departmental inquiry is pending; Copy of confidential reports of last 5 years (photocopy, not originals); Property and liabilities statement as on 31-03-2025.
